title: VideoEngine
description: Play videos directly on your HUD
body:
VideoEngine


VideoEngine is a simple plugin that lets you play videos directly on the HUD using resource packs and the player's actionbar.


Notes

- This plugin is experimental. There may be an impact on server performance if a large number of players are watching a video at the same time. - Videos are downscaled and can play at up to 20 FPS

Installation

1. Put VideoEngine.jar in your server’s plugins folder 2. Upload a video on VideoEngine’s converter tool and follow the instructions

Permissions

- ``videoengine.play`` - Play a video for yourself - ``videoengine.stop`` - Stop a video for yourself - ``videoengine.play.others`` - Play a video for yourself or other players - ``videoengine.stop.others`` - Stop a video for yourself or other players
